lines.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Tenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਜੀਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso daan dehu jee sa(n)tahu jaat jeeu balihaar ||
lines.translation: Give me that blessing, O Dear Saints, for which my soul would be a sacrifice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਹੀ ਉਰਝਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan mohee pa(n)ch dohee urajh nikat basio taakee saran saadhooaa doot sa(n)g nivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Enticed by pride, entrapped and plundered by the five thieves, still, you live near them. I have come to the Sanctuary of the Holy, and I have been rescued from my association with those demons. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kot janam jon bhramio haar pario duaar ||1||
lines.translation: I wandered through millions of lifetimes and incarnations. I am so very tired - I have fallen at God's Door. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa gobi(n)d bhaee milio naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe has become Kind to me; He has blessed me with the Support of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: dulabh janam saphal naanak bhav utaar paar ||2||1||45||
lines.translation: This precious human life has become fruitful and prosperous; O Nanak, I am carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||45||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl, Eleventh House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He Himself has come to me, in His Natural Way.
I know nothing, and I show nothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਲੇ ਭੋਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh milio sukh baale bhole ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I have met God through innocent faith, and He has blessed me with peace. ||1||Pause||
By the good fortune of my destiny, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
I do not go out anywhere; I dwell in my own home.
God, the Treasure of Virtue, has been revealed in this body-robe. ||1||
I have fallen in love with His Feet; I have abandoned everything else.
In the places and interspaces, He is All-pervading.
With loving joy and excitement, Nanak speaks His Praises. ||2||1||46||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
It is so hard to meet the Lord of the Universe, my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paramit roop aga(n)m agochar rahio sarab samaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: His Form is Immeasurable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਨਿ ਭਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਕਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahan bhavan naahee paaio paaio anik ukat chaturaaee ||1||
lines.translation: By speaking and wandering, nothing is gained; nothing is obtained by clever tricks and devices. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤਨ ਜਤਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jatan jatan anik upaav re tau milio jau kirapaaee ||
lines.translation: People try all sorts of things, but the Lord is only met when He shows His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: prabhoo daiaar kripaar kripaa nidh jan naanak sa(n)t renaaee ||2||2||47||
lines.translation: God is Kind and Compassionate, the Treasure of Mercy; servant Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||47||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
O mother, I meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
Without God, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਾਸਨ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chitavau charanaarabi(n)d saasan nis bhor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I remember His Lotus Feet with every breath, night and day. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਆਪਨ ਤੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: laai preet keen aapan tootat nahee jor ||
lines.translation: He loves me and makes me His Own; my union with Him shall never be broken.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੋੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: praan man dhan sarabasou har gun nidhe sukh mor ||1||
lines.translation: He is my breath of life, mind, wealth and everything. The Lord is the Treasure of Virtue and Peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਰਾਮ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਿਦ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: eet oot raam pooran nirakhat rid khor ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, the Lord is perfectly pervading; He is seen deep within the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t saran taran naanak binasio dukh ghor ||2||3||48||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, I am carried across; O Nanak, the terrible pain has been taken away. ||2||3||48||
Kaanraa, Fifth Mehl:
God's humble servant is in love with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajano too meet meraa grihi terai sabh kehu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are my Friend, my very best Friend; everything is in Your Home. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਤਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: maan maa(n)gau taan maa(n)gau dhan lakhamee sut deh ||1||
lines.translation: I beg for honor, I beg for strength; please bless me with wealth, property and children. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat bhugat pooran paramaana(n)d param nidhaan ||
lines.translation: You are the Technology of liberation, the Way to worldly success, the Perfect Lord of Supreme Bliss, the Transcendent Treasure.
